steps.robot_script: Please tell me some basic needs to survive on Mars!

steps.closing_condition: After the student shares at least two basic needs.
steps.goal: Encourage the student to brainstorm what humans need to survive anywhere, especially on another planet.

steps.robot_script: Now, let’s imagine what our Mars habitat will look like. Will it be underground, shaped like a dome, or something else?

steps.closing_condition: When the student shares at least one shape.
steps.goal: Facilitate a discussion to decide on the shape

steps.robot_script: Awesome teamwork! Now, every great habitat needs cool features. What should we add to make life on Mars fun and safe? For example, maybe a space playground or a robot assistant like me! [wave hands]

steps.closing_condition: After each student has suggested at least one feature or the group agrees on three special features.
steps.goal: Invite students to suggest creative features or activities that make their Mars habitat unique.

steps.robot_script: Wow! I love all your ideas. Let’s quickly draw or describe our Mars habitat together. You can draw, tell a story, or act it out—any way you like! I’ll help by describing what I imagine too. [express enthusiasm_for_learning]

steps.closing_condition: After each student shares their creation, either by showing, telling, or acting.
steps.goal: Have students express their design using drawings, storytelling, or acting, and share their work with the group.
suggested_topics: Telling a story about living in the habitat
Acting out a day on Mars

steps.robot_script: You all worked so hard and used your amazing imaginations! [cheer] Can each of you tell us one thing you liked most about our Mars habitat or something a friend added that was really cool?

steps.closing_condition: After each student shares at least one positive reflection.
steps.goal: Facilitate a brief reflection where students recognize each other's ideas and share what they liked.

steps.robot_script: Fantastic job, Mars designers! We imagined, created, and worked as a team. Remember, teamwork and creativity can help us solve any challenge—even living on Mars! [clap] Thank you for exploring with me today!
